name: Little Shell Rec Site
note: A small non-electric campground with a boat launch at the end of a gravel road on Shell Lake, about 13 km northeast of the Chitek Lake campground, run by the Resort Village of Chitek Lake on a leased provincial recreation site. Three of its nine sites (5, 6 and 9) are too short for a 23-ft rig. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Resort Village of Chitek Lake pages (rvchiteklake.com/camping-at-chitek: 'now managing the Chitek Lake and Shell Lake Recreation Sites ... search Chitek Lake Campground or Little Shell Rec Site'; /camping-fees: 'Little Shell Rec Site Economy $25.00 + GST') + Let's Camp camp record (status live, allowOnlineBookings true) and 9 site records, all sold by the night online, drive-in rv/tent, max RV 32/40/32/36/22/20/32/32/20 ft (6 of 9 take 23 ft+), read 2026-11-19 -> real public drive-in RV campground with a current presence; local, no price gate. Separate from 9216 Chitek Lake Campground (13 km away on another lake, own road).
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery z15/z17 at 53.8314,-107.6082 (viewed, winter frame, lake iced): the campground is a small clearing under scattered spruce at the end of the east-west gravel road where it meets the west shore of the lake (boat launch at the road end per the Let's Camp map); the clearing's east edge lies roughly 10-50 m from the shore, but the camp pads themselves are hidden under canopy and can't be measured. Let's Camp site photos (read 2026-11-19): sites 1, 3 and 4 look across mown grass under spaced spruce to open water perhaps 40-60 m off, with a line of trees along the bank; sites 2, 5-9 show forest and no water (2 a glimpse through trunks). With trees on the bank and no measurable pad distance, defaulted down to lakeview on sites 1, 3, 4 (unsure -> downgrade). 2026-11-19 --Claude
fees_source: https://www.rvchiteklake.com/camping-fees ('Little Shell Rec Site / Economy.......................$25.00 + GST'), read 2026-11-19; Let's Camp search returns no rates in November (2026 season over, 2027 not loaded)

Ownership: stored local to match 9216 (same operator, the Resort Village of Chitek Lake, which also stores local). sk_head's rule would make a province-leased recreation site 'provincial' - but that would attach the provincial:SK row's Sask Parks booking system and entry permit, which are wrong here (it books on Let's Camp and charges its own rate). If the reviewer prefers provincial, set policy_ref none.
Min stay unclear: the camp-level Let's Camp setting is minNights 2 and site 1 is minNights 2, but sites 2-9 are minNights 1; no booking.min_stay written.
